page_title: LIL 1-0 MNT | Lille v Montpellier 03/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+8' Lille are ruled offside.
90+6' Becir Omeragic (Montpellier) has tested the patience of referee Benoit Millot and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+6' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Montpellier comes to nothing.
90+6' Montpellier are passing the ball across the pitch and keep possession. However, an opponent intercepts a pass and the situation changes. Now Montpellier have a corner.
90+5' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Montpellier.

90+5' Sacha Delaye (Montpellier) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance. The ball goes behind for a corner. Montpellier will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+3' Yusuf Yazici (Lille) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
90+3' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 15:8.
90+1' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Ivan Cavaleiro as he is replaced by Edon Zhegrova (Lille).
90+1' The goal by Montpellier won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' Wait! Referee Benoit Millot has indicated he is going to review the Montpellier goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
89' Maybe there was an infringement in the build up to the Montpellier goal as the referee signals a VAR review. This could get tense.
89' It is in the back of the net! Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) coolly beats the goalkeeper.
87' Montpellier will take a corner kick.

87' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger. The linesman makes the right call and Montpellier will have a corner.
86' A substitution has been made. Mousa Al-Tamari goes off and Sacha Delaye (Montpellier) comes on.
86' Paulo Fonseca has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) replacing Angel Gomes.
85' Here comes a substitution. Jonathan David is given a rest as he is replaced by Samuel Umtiti (Lille).

84' Kelvin Yeboah (Montpellier) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Lucas Chevalier makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom right corner.
84' Ivan Cavaleiro (Lille) sends a precise pass into the box, but Angel Gomes loses the one-on-one with the defender. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Montpellier.
82' Ivan Cavaleiro (Lille) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
82' Becir Omeragic (Montpellier) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.

80' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) missed a great opportunity! He finds himself some space near the penalty spot and plants a header goalwards which lacks both power and accuracy. The ball goes well wide of the right post! The ball goes out of play and Lille will have a goal kick.
78' Angel Gomes (Lille) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
78' Shots on target – 6:4.
77' Benoit Millot blows his whistle as Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
77' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
76' Substitution. Kelvin Yeboah (Montpellier) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Wahbi Khazri walks off.
74' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Teji Savanier (Montpellier), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

74' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom right corner is, however, superbly saved by Lucas Chevalier! The ball is out of play. Montpellier win a corner kick.
73' Alexsandro (Lille) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Benoit Millot had an easy-decision to make.
73' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) stretches for the rebound inside the box, but can only send it high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lille will have a goal kick.
72' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his low drive to the left post is smartly dealt with by Lucas Chevalier.
71' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball goes out of play and Lille will have a goal kick.
70' Lille will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.
70' Lille have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Remy Cabella trots off the pitch and is replaced by Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille).

69' Lille are playing some nice combination football, sending it precisely from player to player, but a defender shows good anticipation and ends the move with a good block. The ball goes out of play. Lille are awarded a corner kick.
67' Great teamplay by Montpellier as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
66' Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
65' Jonathan David (Lille) finds himself in a promising position after receiving an excellent pass into the box, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention to avert the threat.
63' Tiago Santos (Lille) commits a rough foul. Benoit Millot stops the game and makes a call.
62' Montpellier can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
62' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier). The referee signals a corner kick to Montpellier.
61' Michel Der Zakarian decides to make a substitution. Akor Adams will be replaced by Jordan Ferri (Montpellier).
60' We are about to witness a substitution. Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) is replacing Leo Leroy.
59' Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.

57' A defender mistimes his tackle on the edge on the box and let's in Tiago Santos (Lille). It's a decent effort but his shot flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Montpellier will have a goal kick.
56' Referee Benoit Millot halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Michel Der Zakarian, then shows him a yellow.
56' Although Michel Der Zakarian (Montpellier) is just on the bench, Benoit Millot has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
55' The resulting set piece from Lille is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
55' The Lille players find the open spaces by moving the ball around, but the move ends with an involuntarily pass to the opposition. It will be a corner kick for Lille.
54' Yusuf Yazici (Lille) receives a precise low pass and attempts to finish. The shot, however, goes well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Montpellier will have a goal kick.
52' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Benoit Millot blows for a foul.
52' The ball possession at the moment is 59:41.
50' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Angel Gomes (Lille) was quite harsh and Benoit Millot didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
47' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) latched onto a loose pass on the edge of the box and let fly, but Lucas Chevalier saw it all the way and made a fine save to deny him.
46' The second half has just started.
45+6' Benoit Millot blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+5' Jonathan David (Lille) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle as Yusuf Yazici (Lille) was too aggressive in his challenge.
45+3' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
45+2' Benoit Millot blows his whistle and it's Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
45+2' Great touch by Remy Cabella (Lille) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!
45+1' 6 additional min. will be played.
45' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The linesman signals a throw-in for Lille.
44' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) passes the ball onto Jonathan David, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
43' Ivan Cavaleiro (Lille) tries to latch onto a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defending players intercepts the effort and the danger passes.
42' Lille are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
41' 0:3 – these are the offside statistics for both sides in this match.
39' Yusuf Yazici (Lille) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
38' Akor Adams (Montpellier) is flagged for offside.

37' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) is picked out by his teammate with a brilliant short pass, but it takes him too long to control the ball inside the box and this allows one of the defending players to rob him. The ball is behind the touchline and Montpellier will take a throw-in.

35' What an opportunity! Alexsandro (Lille) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross into the box from the free kick, and he plants a header from near the penalty spot which goes a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Montpellier will have a goal kick.
35' Remy Cabella (Lille) will take the free kick.
34' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Lille.
33' The Lille players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
31' Joris Chotard (Montpellier) makes a rough challenge and Benoit Millot blows his whistle for a foul.
30' Akor Adams (Montpellier) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball goes out of play and Lille will have a goal kick.
28' The ball possession is 67:33.
26' A cooling break is underway.

25' Falaye Sacko (Montpellier) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Benoit Millot with no other option than to blow for a foul. Lille are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.

24' Wahbi Khazri crosses the ball right onto the head of Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier), but his firm header from around the penalty spot shoots well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Lille will have a goal kick.
23' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
21' Tiago Santos (Lille) takes a rebound on the edge of the box and slams the ball well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Montpellier.
21' Yusuf Yazici (Lille) will take the corner.
20' The corner kick from Yusuf Yazici (Lille) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders. Lille will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

20' Lille keep the ball well and push forward with purpose, but here comes an interception from the opposition. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Lille will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
19' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Akor Adams, but Lucas Chevalier displays great awareness to stop him.
18' Flag goes up against Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
17' Remy Cabella (Lille) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
16' Tiago Santos (Lille) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Benoit Millot has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
15' The resulting corner from Remy Cabella (Lille) is cleared.
14' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. Lille get a corner.
12' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Lille.
12' Ball possession – 61:39.
10' Joris Chotard (Montpellier) unleashes a long-range free kick, but the goalkeeper does well to make a fine save.
9' The free kick is delivered by Teji Savanier (Montpellier) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
8' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) commits a rough challenge and Benoit Millot blows his whistle for an infringement.
7' Jonathan David (Lille) decided to shoot after receiving a sweet pass. If it wasn't for Benjamin Lecomte's superb save the ball would have probably ended up in the top of the net.
5' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
5' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
4' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Benoit Millot signals.
3' 1 - 0 Yusuf Yazici (Lille) proves that he is an excellent free-kick taker after finding the back of the net with a clever shot that goes straight into the bottom left corner!
2' Leo Leroy (Montpellier) makes a strong challenge and Benoit Millot blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Lille.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Lille will kick the game off.
Benoit Millot is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
